description: A company's debt, from its latest 10-K: principal due year by year (tagged maturity schedule), interest rates and covenants quoted from the debt note, the company's own interest-rate sensitivity from its market-risk section, interest paid, operating cash, later 10-Qs and debt 8-Ks, the 8-K agreements it signed, its auditor fees, and its merger adviser fees where it had a merger proxy. Same data as the treasury and credit reports on /boards/work/{ticker}. Argument: company (name, ticker or CIK).
name: get_debt_terms
title: debt terms
